delayed.task: Replace the fixed record with variable-length input and derive a truncation/ownership policy without unbounded ISR copying.

criteria.task: Schedule a nested interrupt or callback entering the same peripheral service while its state is partially updated. Reject unsupported reentrancy or design separate state/serialization with explicit interrupt classes.

delayed.task: Add a second MCU core accessing the service and explain why local interrupt masking no longer provides exclusion.

criteria.task: Feed a burst of five events into an N=4,N-1 capacity queue while foreground is paused. Require accepted1,2,3, dropped4,5, exact drop accounting and bounded acknowledgment/capture work.

delayed.task: Change the overflow policy to retain the newest sample and redesign index ownership before implementing overwrite-oldest.

criteria.task: Compare local interrupt masking, a naturally atomic scalar access and a lock for a two-field invariant. Name excluded participants and show a DMA write unaffected by the mask in the model.

delayed.task: Use a threshold mask instead of a binary mask and derive nesting rules without accidentally lowering an outer threshold.

criteria.task: Protect a foreground/ISR invariant with a declared BASEPRI threshold, then inject a higher-urgency interrupt and DMA completion. Trace which accesses still occur and redesign ownership where the original exclusion is insufficient.

delayed.task: Move one existing ISR above the threshold and identify every newly invalid shared-state assumption.

criteria.task: Design foreground/ISR publication with fixed live storage and one owner per index/slot. Draw payload-write before publish and reader completion before reuse; distinguish the hosted atomic model from selected compiler interrupt semantics.

delayed.task: Introduce a second ISR producer and derive a new reservation protocol rather than retaining the SPSC proof.

criteria.task: Compile the chosen atomic-width queue for the actual target, inspect alignment, instructions, undefined helpers and helper reentrancy. Mark unavailable cross-toolchains explicitly and reject any helper violating the strict target dependency profile.

delayed.task: Increase the index width and reassess both atomic lowering and wrap/resource assumptions.

criteria.task: Analyze a deliberately premature head publication before payload initialization using a deterministic state model. Repair ordering and ownership, then explain why merely qualifying head/payload volatile does not establish a complete protocol.

delayed.task: Add cacheable DMA-written payload and identify the additional device/cache contract beyond compiler visibility.

criteria.task: Implement the parent's four-slot queue with three usable slots and drop-newest accounting. Reproduce push1,2,3,4,pop,push5,pop,pop,pop yielding1,2,3,5 with one drop; reject zero/one-slot configurations.

delayed.task: Switch to monotonic counters using all slots and prove the modular-distance bound independently.

criteria.task: Pause the producer between payload copy and head publication, then pause the consumer before releasing tail. Exercise index wrap with an independent sequence model and ensure neither partial reads nor early overwrite occur.

delayed.task: Use multiword records and a compiler that lowers copies differently while retaining valid slot ownership.

criteria.task: Measure enqueue-to-consume latency on an available target with sequence IDs and trace timestamps, including dropped events and instrumentation overhead. Keep the queue's ordering/lifetime proof beside the distribution.

delayed.task: Increase burstiness at unchanged average rate and predict capacity/drop/latency changes before measurement.
